senses.definition: n.f. dearth, destitution (i.e. diminution, cf. ܒܨܺܝܪܽܘܬܳܐ PS572; v. also vb. בצר 𝔗 Pr 14:28 people reduced)—dearth (= בצרת) עִתּוֹת בּ׳ ψ 9:10; 10:1; pl. בַּצָּרוֹת Je 14:1.
